rootCause: The attacker rolls back the transaction when placing a bet. ToBet, an EOS gambling dApp, was exploited on 18,19 December 2018. Reports attribute a loss of about 22,000 EOS to an attacker exploiting node synchronization flaws, although no primary code or on-chain transaction evidence is available. ToBet was vulnerable to node sync and replay exploitation: the attacker selectively submitted only winning bets by exploiting differences in API and BP node confirmation, allowing profit without contract-level vulnerabilities.
